name: Prevest Denpro Limited
summary: Prevest Denpro Ltd. functions as a producer specializing in dental materials. The company offers a comprehensive range of dental supplies, encompassing composites, glass ionomer cements, cavity liners, bonding agents, core build-up solutions, luting compounds, prophylactic preparations, impression substances, and temporary restorative materials. Established on May 5, 1999, its primary operational base is situated in Samba, India.
